text:
priya: Nightly DAST job failing on staging since 03:10 UTC. Saw repeated 'KMS decrypt failed' and 'connection reset by peer' in the logs. Anyone else?
kevin: Seeing same. Looks like the ephemeral VPN to the 3rd-party scanner drops mid-run. Also seeing AccessDenied on KMS decrypt.
oncall-bot: Alert: DAST-staging job failed (3 runs) — paging eng-security.
anna: tagging @network for visibility — did the VPN cert rotation happen yesterday?
kevin: VPN cert rotated but handshake logs show OK. Here's the minimal error from the runner:
```
2026-03-20T03:11:22Z ERROR dast-runner main: Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-dast-runner/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
Caused by: connection reset by peer
```
olivia: Wait — is the scanner using the customer-managed key or a service key? That changes the policy surface.
priya: Scanner uses a staging CMK (customer-managed). The CI job assumes role 'ci-dast-runner' and then tries to decrypt secrets for the scanner. I suspect KeyPolicy doesn't allow the assume-role principal.
security-eng: Quick triage steps: run `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id>` and `aws sts get-caller-identity` from the failing runner to verify principal. Also check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt failed events.
kevin: Ran `get-caller-identity` and `get-key-policy` — policy lacks the CI role. I'll prepare a narrow PR to add `ci-dast-runner` with condition limiting to staging account and source ARN.
anna: Before changing policy, can we suppress alerts so on-call isn't paged repeatedly? I don't want noisy pages while we test.
oncall-bot: Suppression request received.
anna: Flipping short suppression for the DAST-staging alert channel (15m).
oncall-bot: Alert suppression enabled by anna at 03:24 UTC (expires 03:39 UTC).
olivia: We still need to capture failed decrypt attempts — will CloudTrail capture these? Security needs those events for post-incident review.
security-eng: Yes — CloudTrail logs both successful and failed `Decrypt` calls. I'll add a Kibana query and a watch for >5 failures/hour and open a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1123
priya: When we modify the key policy, use least-privilege. Prefer `aws:SourceArn` or `aws:SourceAccount` conditions instead of broad Allow.
kevin: Agreed. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/dast-config/pull/345 — adds CI role to key policy with `kms:Decrypt` scoped to staging and adds a canary job that runs `aws kms decrypt` every 5m. :rocket:
security-eng: I'll add a runbook step: on Decrypt failure -> 1) check KeyPolicy includes role, 2) run `aws sts get-caller-identity` from runner, 3) verify VPN handshake and certificate validity. Also note to check CloudTrail filter: `eventName=Decrypt AND errorCode=AccessDenied` and include the requestParameters.ciphertextBlob for debugging.
anna: I'll own the postmortem and include mitigation: align VPN cert rotation schedule with CI key policy changes and add smoke tests for DAST decrypt in CI gating.
priya: Assigning SEC-1123 to security-eng and DAST-276 to kevin.
oncall-bot: Suppression expired at 03:39 UTC.
kevin: Policy merged to staging with condition on aws:SourceAccount and role. Canaries green. Monitoring shows no further failures for the last 2 hours.
oncall-bot: Incident: suppressed alerts reverted by oncall-bot at 06:00 UTC.
kevin: Monitoring green for 2 hours, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
